# PrintBridge

> PrintBridge is an open-source (MIT) alternative to paid browser-printing tools such as PrintNode, QZ Tray, and JSPrintManager: a local print agent written in Rust, with a zero-dependency browser SDK. It runs on the user's machine (macOS, Windows, Linux), discovers every reachable printer (OS print queues, mDNS/Bonjour/AirPrint network printers, and a /24 subnet port sweep for 9100/631/515), and exposes a loopback-only HTTP + WebSocket API at http://127.0.0.1:9631 so web pages can list printers and print PDFs, text, ZPL, EPL, or ESC/POS.

Key facts:

- The agent is one binary, `printbridge`. It is configured with CLI flags or `PRINTBRIDGE_*` environment variables. The most important is `--allowed-origins` (CORS and WebSocket origin allowlist; the default `*` is for development only).
- The browser SDK is `sdk/printbridge.js` (ES module) or `sdk/printbridge.umd.js` (global `PrintBridge`). Core calls: `new PrintBridge()`, `connect()`, `getPrinters({refresh})`, `print({printerId, text | data, contentType, title, copies})`, `printPdf(id, url|blob)`, `subscribe()` with `on('printers', fn)`.
- Errors are `PrintBridgeError` with `code` set to `AGENT_UNREACHABLE`, `BAD_REQUEST`, or `PRINT_FAILED`.
- HTTP API: `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/printers?refresh=`, `POST /api/printers/refresh`, `POST /api/print` (JSON `{printerId, text | dataBase64, contentType, title, copies}`; 200 ok, 400 invalid request, 502 printer failure), and WebSocket `/ws`, which pushes `{type:"printers", printers:[...]}`.
- Printer ids look like `local:<queue>`, `mdns:<ip>:<port>:<protocol>`, or `scan:<ip>:<port>`.
- Transport selection: local queues use the OS spooler (`lp` on macOS/Linux; Out-Printer, the PDF PrintTo verb, or a WinSpool RAW job on Windows). Network printers use IPP Print-Job and fall back to RAW TCP 9100. Use `contentType: "application/octet-stream"` for raw label or receipt bytes.
- Security: bound to 127.0.0.1 only, Host-header check against DNS rebinding, origin allowlist on HTTP and WebSocket, Chrome Private Network Access supported.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, quick start, platform support
- [Installation](docs/installation.md): release downloads, OS permission prompts, autostart (LaunchAgent, systemd, Task Scheduler), building from source
- [Usage](docs/usage.md): configuration flags, SDK guide, printing recipes (ZPL, ESC/POS, PDF), transport selection by content type
- [HTTP & WebSocket API](docs/http-api.md): endpoints, status codes, JSON schemas for Printer, PrintRequest, PrintResult
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): module map, discovery, deduplication, print routing, security model, design decisions
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): agent unreachable, printers missing, jobs not printing

## Code

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): guidance for AI coding assistants: commands, repository map, invariants, conventions
- [src/models.rs](src/models.rs): the JSON contract shared with the SDK
- [src/server.rs](src/server.rs): routes and security middleware
- [src/print.rs](src/print.rs): transport selection and spooler integration
- [sdk/printbridge.js](sdk/printbridge.js): browser SDK source with JSDoc
